label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 45
title: MVP: Platform Operator console - tenants, licenses/keys, trials, tiers, pricing, provisioning
body: The operator (us) console: create/suspend tenants; issue/edit/extend/suspend LICENSE KEYS; configure TRIALS (x days/months, expiry); define TIERS + which feature-groups each tier includes; set provisional PRICING; view usage/billing; feature flags. Distinct from a customer's own admin.
